decks.expectation: Mardu aggro deck that builds a threatening combat board and exploits Isshin to double attack-trigger value, especially token generation and combat payoffs.

Dimir Zombie deck that generates and recycles Zombie bodies, sacrifices them for value, and leverages Wilhelt’s replacement tokens alongside recursion and tribal payoffs.
